# Dashandots Technology

> Dashandots Technology is a custom software development company based in Gurugram, India. We build enterprise-grade ERP, CRM, TMS, HMS, e-commerce and custom web/mobile applications for SMEs and growing businesses in India and internationally.

We deliver software from requirements and UX design through development, deployment and post-launch support. Our stack spans PHP/Laravel, Node.js, React, Flutter, MySQL/PostgreSQL, and embedded firmware (ESP32, STM32, FreeRTOS). Modules, integrations, data migration, ownership and ongoing support are defined in each project scope and agreement.

Target clients: small and medium enterprises, logistics and transport operators, hospitals and clinics, retail chains and manufacturers evaluating software for their operational workflows.

## Company

- [Home](https://dashandots.com/): Overview of services, portfolio and client proof points
- [Contact / Enquiry](https://dashandots.com/#contact): Request a proposal or scoping call
- [AI Project Scoping Assistant](https://dashandots.com/#ai-brief): Interactive wizard that drafts a requirement brief and indicative timeline
- [Portfolio & Live Demos](https://dashandots.com/portfolio): Client work and hosted product demos

## Services

- [Custom ERP & CRM Development](https://dashandots.com/services/erp-development/): Modules, cost drivers, Tally integration prerequisites, migration and phased delivery for Indian SMEs
- [Manufacturing ERP Systems](https://dashandots.com/services/manufacturing-erp/): Multi-level BOMs, job cards, shop-floor routing, WIP inventory, quality control, vendor procurement and machine scheduling
- [Web & Mobile Applications](https://dashandots.com/services/web-mobile-apps/): Full-stack web apps (React, Node.js, PHP, Laravel) and Flutter mobile apps for iOS and Android; portals, dashboards, SaaS platforms
- [E-commerce & Portals](https://dashandots.com/services/ecommerce/): B2B/B2C stores, dealer portals, multi-vendor marketplaces with GST invoicing and payment gateway integration
- [Industry Systems (TMS, HMS, PMS)](https://dashandots.com/services/industry-systems/): Transport, hospital and hotel property management systems
- [Data Analytics & AI](https://dashandots.com/services/data-analytics/): BI dashboards, ETL pipelines, ML forecasting, LLM workflow integrations
- [IoT & Embedded Software](https://dashandots.com/services/iot-embedded/): Firmware (ESP32, STM32), MQTT/LoRaWAN device-cloud pipelines, OTA updates, FreeRTOS systems

## Usage Permissions

- AI search citation (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Claude): permitted
- Consult robots.txt for crawler-specific access rules, including training and grounding agents
- The site is server-rendered PHP; core page copy, navigation, FAQs and structured data are available without client-side JavaScript.
